pages.observation: How I read it: P1: caption 'Soon, his slot comes up.' at top-left, then the teal screen label 'NOW · A-12' at top-right. Ravi's face box is in the middle. P2 (lower left): caption 'A quick vitals check first.', then the nurse's balloon 'Hi, Ravi! Just relax your arm for me.' A long tail runs down to the nurse's face box. Ravi is lower left. P3 (lower right): caption 'Dr. Ananya is notified when he's ready.', Ananya's face box, then the teal label 'RAVI · READY'. Issues: (1) 'his' in P1 opens the page and refers back to Ravi on the previous page. Only the label A-12 and the art tie it to him, so make Ravi recognisable in P1. (2) The nurse appears for the first time and is never introduced, so the art must show the role. (3) The nurse's tail is about 160px long, crossing a lot of empty space. The balloon could sit closer to the nurse. (4) In P3, 'when he's ready' could mean ready after vitals or ready as a slot status, but it is understandable. The order is clear and nothing covers a face.
